G3389.definition: μητρολῴας (Rec. -αλῴας, in cl., -αλοίας, see B1., § 3, 3; 6, 2), -ου, ὁ ; (μήτρρ + ἀλοιάω, to smite) ; (a) a matricide: 1Ti.1:9 (AV, R, txt., but see infr.); (b) a smiter of his mother: 1Ti.1:9 (R, mg., cf. Exo.21:15, and see Ellic., CGT, in l).†; (AS)

G3336.definition: μετά-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις), -εως, ἡ ; (μεταλαμβάνω) ; participation, taking, receiving: of food, 1Ti.4:3.†; (AS)

G3311.definition: (μερίζω),  ; 1. a dividing, division: ψυχῆς κ. πνεύματος (i.e. between them or of the things themselves, see Westc., in l), Heb.4:12. ; 2. a dis­tribution, bestowal (cf. μερίζω, 2); pl., Heb.2:4.†; (AS)

G3356.definition: (μετριοπαθής, moderating one's passions), ; to hold one's passions or emotions in restraint; hence, to bear gently with, feel gently towards: Heb.5:2.†; (AS)

G3375.definition: a particle of assurance, verily, truly; εἰ (εἶ) μ. (= cl., ἦ μ. in LXX and π.), now verily, full surely: Heb.6:14 (LXX).†; (AS)

G3315.definition: (μεσίτης), ; to interpose, mediate: ὅρκῳ, Heb.6:17 (MM, ii, 111).†; (AS)

G3331.definition: μετά-θεσις, -εως, ἡ; (μετατίθημι)  ; 1. change of position, removal : Heb.11:5. ; 2. change, as of that which has been established : Heb.7:12 12:27.†; (AS)

G3374.definition: (μῆλον, a sheep or goat)  ; a sheepskin: Heb.11:37.†; (AS)

G3329.definition: μετ-άγω; 1. in Xen., Plut., and later writers, to transfer, transport (so LXX). ; 2. In sense other­wise unknown (see Hort, in l), to turn about, direct: Jas.3:3-4.†; (AS)

G3394.definition: (μιαίνω),  ; 1. prop., the act of defiling. ; 2. = μίασμα (which see) : 2Pe.2:10 (cf. Plut., Mor., 393c).†; (AS)

G3393.definition: (μιαίνω), ; chiefly in trag. and late writers; a stain, defilement: pl., 2Pe.2:20.†; (AS)

G3321.definition: (μεσουρανέω, to be in mid-heaven, of the sun at the meridian), ; the zenith, mid-heaven: Rev.8:13 14:6 19:17.†; (AS)
